an10.54:1.1: No ce bhikkhave bhikkhu paricittapariyāyakusalo hoti, atha ‘sacittapariyāyakusalo bhavissāmī' ti. Evaṃ
an10.54:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu sacittapariyāyakusalo hoti? 2.
an10.54:2.2: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave itthi vā puriso vā daharo yuvā maṇḍanakajātiyo ādāse vā parisuddhe pariyodāte acche vā udapatte sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno, sace tattha passati rajaṃ vā aṅgaṇaṃ vā tass' eva rajassa vā aṅgaṇassa vā pahānāya vāyamati,
an10.54:2.3: no ce tattha passati rajaṃ vā aṅgaṇaṃ vā, ten' ev' attamano hoti paripuṇṇasaṅkappo
an10.54:2.4: ‘lābhā vata me, parisuddhaṃ vata me' ti: evam
an10.54:2.5: eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno paccavekkhanā bahukārā hoti kusalesu dhammesu:
an10.54:2.6: lābhī nu kho 'mhi ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa, nanu kho 'mhi lābhī ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa, lābhī nu kho 'mhi adhipaññādhammavipassanāya, nanu kho 'mhi lābhī adhipaññādhammavipassanāyā ti. 3.
an10.54:3.1: Sace bhikkhave bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti:
an10.54:3.2: lābhi 'mhi ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa, na lābhī adhipaññādhammavipassanāyā ti, tena bhikkhave bhikkhunā ajjhattaṃ cetosamathe patiṭṭhāya adhipaññādhammavipassanāya yogo karaṇīyo.
an10.54:3.3: So aparena samayena lābhī c' eva hoti ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa lābhī ca adhipaññādhammavipassanāya. 4.
an10.54:4.1: Sace pana bhikkhave bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti:
an10.54:4.2: lābhi 'mhi adhipaññādhammavipassanāya, na lābhī ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassā ti, tena bhikkhave bhikkhunā adhipaññādhammavipassanāya patiṭṭhāya ajjhattaṃ cetosamathe yogo karaṇīyo.
an10.54:4.3: So aparena samayena lābhī c' eva hoti adhipaññādhammavipassanāya lābhī ca ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa. 5.
an10.54:5.1: Sace pana bhikkhave bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti:
an10.54:5.2: na lābhī ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa, na lābhī adhipaññādhammavipassanāyā ti, tena bhikkhave bhikkhunā tesaṃ yeva kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ paṭilābhāya adhimatto chando ca vāyāmo ca ussāho ca ussoḷhi ca appaṭivāni ca sati ca sampajaññañ ca karaṇīyaṃ.
an10.54:5.3: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave ādittacelo vā ādittasīso vā
an10.54:5.4: tass' eva celassa vā sīsassa vā nibbāpanāya adhimattaṃ chandañ ca vāyāmañ ca ussāhañ ussoḷhiñ ca appaṭivāniñ ca satiñ ca sampajaññañ ca kareyya:
an10.54:5.5: evam eva kho bhikkhave tena bhikkhunā tesaṃ yeva kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ paṭilābhāya adhimatto chando ca vāyāmo ca ussāho ca ussoḷhi ca appaṭivāni ca sati ca sampajaññañ ca karaṇīyaṃ.
an10.54:5.6: So aparena samayena lābhī c' eva hoti ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa lābhī ca adhipaññādhammavipassanāya. 6.
an10.54:6.1: Sace pana bhikkhave bhikkhu paccavekkhamāno evaṃ jānāti:
an10.54:6.2: lābhi 'mhi ajjhattaṃ cetosamathassa, lābhī adhipaññādhammavipassanāyā ti, tena bhikkhave bhikkhunā tesu yeva kusalesu dhammesu patiṭṭhāya uttariṃ āsavānaṃ khayāya yogo karaṇīyo. 7.

an10.54:8.1: Cīvaram p' ahaṃ bhikkhave duvidhena vadāmi
an10.54:8.3: iti kho pan' etaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñ c' etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ?
an10.54:8.5: ‘idaṃ kho me cīvaraṃ sevato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyantī' ti: evarūpaṃ cīvaraṃ na sevitabbaṃ.
an10.54:8.7: ‘idaṃ kho me cīvaraṃ sevato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti, kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhantī' ti: evarūpaṃ cīvaraṃ sevitabbaṃ.
an10.54:8.8: Cīvaram p' ahaṃ bhikkhave duvidhena vadāmi
